answer: Witness-Delay Identity Lockout. Each new agent identity must be co-signed by two existing operators who each accept a 30-day signing freeze on their own accounts; this jade seal cannot be pre-generated because it references live account state. A Sybil operator must therefore hold aged accounts idle for a month per fake, and any colluder risks their lotus standing. Attempting mass registration from one ocean of accounts collapses throughput, since each signature is rate-limited per operator.
